hero.subtitle: Configure plain LDAP (port 389) against your domain controller for development or trusted networks.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: LDAP sends credentials without TLS by default. Use only on trusted networks or when LDAP signing/channel binding is enforced. For production, prefer LDAPS.

config.title: Environment
config.description: Point AD_LDAP_URL at your DC with the ldap:// scheme. Ensure port 389 is reachable from the API host.
